title: Best-of-Depth: Learning Exploratory Dynamics in Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.04663v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Looped Transformers extend inference-time computation through repeated latent-state updates, but final-depth training does not directly encourage useful intermediate alternatives. We introduce Best-of-Depth (BoD), which trains a recurrent trajectory as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths. Different valid targets can be matched at different depths without architectural changes or depth-specific labels. An exact-match analysis connects this objective to solution coverage. On N-Queens completion and graph coloring, BoD improves coverage over final-depth and intermediate-supervision objectives. N-Queens coverage reaches 91.03%, versus 45.75% for final-depth training. Further experiments show discovery beyond the training depth and recovery of solutions withheld from teacher pools on familiar inputs. translated_title: Best-of-Depth：在循环Transformer中学习探索性动力学
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复的潜在状态更新来扩展推理时的计算，但最终深度训练并不直接鼓励有用的中间替代方案。我们提出了Best-of-Depth（BoD）方法，通过最小化跨深度的预测损失，将一条循环轨迹训练为候选解集合。不同的有效目标可以在不同深度被匹配，无需架构改动或针对特定深度的标签。精确匹配分析将该目标与解覆盖范围联系起来。在N皇后补全和图着色任务上，BoD相比最终深度训练和中间监督目标提高了覆盖率：N皇后覆盖率达到91.03%，而最终深度训练仅为45.75%。进一步实验表明，该方法能够发现超出训练深度的解，并在熟悉输入上恢复教师池中未包含的解。使用BoD对预训练的循环语言模型进行微调，其汇总代码生成成功率高于最终深度训练。
tldr: 提出Best-of-Depth方法，通过跨深度最小化预测损失将循环Transformer的推理轨迹训练为候选解集合，无需架构改动即可显著提升N皇后补全和图着色等任务的解覆盖率（91.03% 对比 45.75%）。
en_tdlr: Best-of-Depth trains the recurrent trajectory of looped transformers as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths, significantly improving solution coverage on N-Queens completion and graph coloring (91.03% vs 45.75%) without architectural changes.
